q: Heat is the form of energy that can be transferred from one system to another as a result of ____ difference.
e: Heat transfer ဖြစ်ရန် temperature gradient လိုအပ်သည်။

q: Heat transfer is a discipline of thermal engineering that concerns the generation, use, conversion, and exchange of ____ energy between systems.
e: Heat transfer ၏ အချက်အချာသည် thermal energy ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Thermodynamics deals with ____ states by outlining the relationship between energy and work.
e: Thermodynamics သည် equilibrium states ကို အဓိကထားသည်။

q: One of the basic requirement for heat transfer is the presence of a ____ difference.
e: Temperature ကွာခြားမှုက heat transfer ကို မောင်းနှင်သည်။

q: There can be no net heat transfer between two systems that are at the ____ temperature.
e: Temperature တူသော systems များသည် thermal equilibrium တွင် ရှိသည်။

q: There are three basic ways of heat transfer; namely, heat conduction, heat convection and heat ____.
e: Radiation သည် heat transfer ၏ တတိယ mode ဖြစ်သည်။

q: In fluids, heat is mainly transferred by ____, in which the motion of the fluid itself carries heat from one place to another.
e: Convection တွင် fluid motion ပါဝင်သည်။

q: In solid, heat is transferred by ____ process in which heat energy is transferred among the adjacent parts of the material without the motion of the material itself.
e: Conduction သည် material ၏ bulk motion မရှိဘဲ ဖြစ်ပေါ်သည်။

q: The third way to transfer heat energy is by radiation process in the form of ____ waves.
e: Radiation သည် electromagnetic waves ဖြင့် energy လွှဲပြောင်းသည်။

q: The individual parts of a medium do not move whole in heat ____.
e: Conduction တွင် particles များ တုန်ခါရုံသာဖြစ်သည်။

q: Heat energy is transferred by successive distribution among the ____ parts in heat conduction.
e: Energy သည် ကပ်လျက် particles သို့ ကူးစက်သည်။

q: When heat is transferred via conduction, heat energy is transferred internally by ____ of atoms and molecules.
e: Atomic vibrations များက conduction ကို အထောက်အကူပြုသည်။

q: Metals have many ____ electrons.
e: Free electrons များက thermal conduction ကို ကူညီသည်။

q: Since these free electrons can carry heat, metals are generally very good ____ of heat.
e: Metals များသည် thermal conductors အလွန်ကောင်းသည်။

q: The rate of heat conduction through a material of cross-sectional area A is proportional to the temperature difference $\Delta T$, but is inversely proportional to the ____ $l$ of the material.
e: ပိုထူသော materials များသည် conduction rate ကို လျှော့ချသည်။

q: where k is the ____ of the material, which is a measure of the ability of a material to conduct heat.
e: k သည် thermal conductivity ကို ကိုယ်စားပြုသည်။

q: The ratio $\frac{T_2-T_1}{l}$ is called ____ gradient.
e: Distance တစ်လျှောက် temperature ပြောင်းလဲမှုဖြစ်သည်။

q: This mathematical model of heat conduction was first formulated by the French physicist ____ in his Fourier's law of heat conduction.
e: Fourier က heat conduction နိယာမကို ဖော်ထုတ်ခဲ့သည်။

q: Negative sign indicates that temperature T must ____ as distance x increases.
e: Heat သည် ပူသောနေရာမှ အေးသောနေရာသို့ စီးသည်။

q: The thermal conductivity of a material can be defined as the rate of heat transfer per unit area per unit ____ gradient.
e: Thermal conductivity ၏ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ဖွင့်ဆိုချက်ဖြစ်သည်။

q: A high value for thermal conductivity indicates that the material is a good thermal conductor, and a low value indicates that the material is a poor thermal conductor or thermal ____.
e: Conductivity နိမ့်သော materials များသည် insulators အဖြစ် လုပ်ဆောင်သည်။

q: Note that materials such as copper and silver that are good ____ conductors are also good heat conductors, and have high values of thermal conductivity.
e: Electric conductors ကောင်းများသည် အများအားဖြင့် heat conductors လည်း ကောင်းသည်။

q: Materials such as rubber, wood, and styrofoam are poor conductors of heat and have ____ conductivity values.
e: Insulators များတွင် thermal conductivity နိမ့်သည်။

q: Heat convection is the flow of heat through a fluid from places of higher temperature to places of lower temperature by movement of the ____ itself.
e: Convection အတွက် fluid ၏ bulk movement လိုအပ်သည်။

q: In heat convection, the transfer of energy occurs between an object and its environment due to fluid ____.
e: Fluid motion က convective heat transfer ကို မောင်းနှင်သည်။

q: Convection currents are set up in the fluid because the hotter part of the fluid is not as dense as the cooler part, so there is an upward ____ force on the hotter fluid.
e: Buoyancy က natural convection currents ကို မောင်းနှင်သည်။

q: Convection occurs only in a liquid or a gas, never in a ____.
e: Solids များတွင် convection currents မဖြစ်နိုင်။

q: Buoyant force is what drives ____ convection, where the pressure difference between air heated by heat sources and surrounding ambient air drives the hot air upwards.
e: Natural convection ကို buoyancy က မောင်းနှင်သည်။

q: The basic equation for the rate of convection heat transfer is known as ____ law of cooling.
e: Newton's law သည် convective cooling ကို ဖော်ပြသည်။

q: where H is the rate of heat convection, q is the convective heat transfer ____.
e: q သည် convective heat transfer coefficient ကို ကိုယ်စားပြုသည်။

q: When $T_2 > T_1$, heat is gained by the object and H is ____.
e: Heat ရရှိခြင်းကြောင့် convection rate အပေါင်းဖြစ်သည်။

q: Heat radiation is a transfer of heat that does not require a ____ medium.
e: Radiation သည် vacuum ထဲဖြတ်သန်းနိုင်သည်။

q: Heat is transferred by thermal radiation which are electromagnetic waves that pass through a medium or even ____.
e: Electromagnetic waves အတွက် physical medium မလိုအပ်။

q: Unlike conduction and convection, the transfer of energy by radiation does not require an ____ medium.
e: Radiation အတွက် ကြားခံ matter မလိုအပ်။

q: In fact, energy transfer by radiation is the fastest (at the speed of ____) and it suffers no attenuation in a vacuum.
e: Thermal radiation သည် speed of light ဖြင့် သွားသည်။

q: Thermal radiation is the form of radiation emitted by bodies because of their ____.
e: Temperature က thermal radiation emission ကို သတ်မှတ်သည်။

q: All bodies at a temperature above ____ zero emit thermal radiation.
e: 0 K အထက်ရှိ အရာဝတ္ထု မည်သည့်အရာမဆို thermal radiation ထုတ်လွှတ်သည်။

q: Thermal radiation differs from other forms of electromagnetic radiation such as X-rays, gamma rays, microwave and radio wave that are not related to ____.
e: Thermal radiation သည် temperature ပေါ်သာ တင်းကျပ်စွာ မူတည်သည်။

q: Radiation is mostly considered to be a ____ phenomenon for solids that are opaque to thermal radiation.
e: Opaque solids များသည် radiation နှင့် surface တွင် အဓိက အပြန်အလှန်သက်ရောက်သည်။

q: The object which can absorb all the electromagnetic radiations falling upon it is called a ____.
e: Blackbody သည် perfect absorber ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The total ____ power is defined as the total radiant energy of different wavelengths emitted from unit area of a surface of a body in one second.
e: Total emissive power သည် radiant energy ထုတ်လွှတ်မှုကို တိုင်းသည်။

q: The total emissive power of a blackbody is directly proportional to the ____ power of absolute temperature.
e: Stefan-Boltzmann law သည် fourth power ကို သုံးသည်။

q: The radiation emitted by all real surfaces is ____ than the radiation emitted by a blackbody at the same temperature.
e: Real surfaces များသည် perfect emitters မဟုတ်။

q: Emissivity is defined as the ____ of the total emissive power of an object to that of the blackbody, at the same temperature and wavelength.
e: Emissivity သည် နှိုင်းယှဉ်သော ratio ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Emissivity of an object depends to a large extent on how ____ it is.
e: Surface ၏ တောက်ပမှုက reflectivity နှင့် emissivity ကို သက်ရောက်သည်။

q: A black object is a good absorber and a good radiator whose emissivity is close to ____.
e: Perfect blackbodies တွင် emissivity သည် 1 ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Note that the emissivity of an object depends on the ____ of radiation.
e: Emissivity သည် incident wavelength အလိုက် ကွာခြားသည်။

q: The net energy change is simply the difference between the radiated energy and the ____ energy.
e: Net radiation သည် emission မှ absorption ကို နုတ်ခြင်းဖြစ်သည်။

q: Thermodynamics is the study of systems involving energy in the form of heat and ____.
e: Thermodynamics သည် heat နှင့် mechanical work ကို ချိတ်ဆက်သည်။

q: A good example of a thermodynamic system is gas confined by a ____ in a cylinder.
e: Piston က gas ကို work လုပ်ခွင့်ပေးသည်။

q: Thermal ____ is an important concept in thermodynamics.
e: Thermal equilibrium သည် net heat flow မရှိကြောင်း ဆိုလိုသည်။

q: When two systems are in thermal equilibrium, there is no net ____ transfer between them.
e: Equilibrium ဆိုသည်မှာ net heat transfer သုညဖြစ်သည်။

q: The ____ law of thermodynamics is a simple definition of thermodynamic equilibrium.
e: Zeroth law သည် equilibrium ကို transitive အဖြစ် သတ်မှတ်သည်။

q: It states that: When two objects are separately in thermodynamic equilibrium with a ____ object, they all are in thermodynamic equilibrium with each other.
e: Zeroth law သည် တတိယ reference အရာဝတ္ထုပေါ် မူတည်သည်။

q: The first law of thermodynamics is an application of the conservation ____ for heat and thermodynamic processes.
e: First law သည် conservation of energy ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The first law of thermodynamics relates the change in ____ energy of a system to heat added and the work done by the system.
e: Internal energy သည် heat နှင့် work ဖြင့် ပြောင်းလဲသည်။

q: The change in internal energy U of a system is equal to the net heat flow Q into the system minus the total ____ W done by the system.
e: System က လုပ်သော work သည် internal energy ကို လျှော့ချသည်။

q: Q is ____ if heat is added to the system, and negative if heat is removed.
e: ပေါင်းထည့်သော heat က system energy ကို တိုးစေသည်။

q: W is positive if work is done by the system, and negative if work is done ____ the system.
e: ဤ convention တွင် system ပေါ် လုပ်သော work သည် negative ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The internal energy U of a system is defined as the sum of the energies of all the ____ particles.
e: Internal energy သည် microscopic energies ၏ ပေါင်းလဒ်ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The internal energy of ideal gases depends only on ____, not on volume or pressure.
e: Ideal gas ၏ internal energy သည် temperature ၏ function ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Note that internal energy of an ideal gas is directly proportional to the ____ temperature.
e: Proportionality အတွက် Kelvin scale လိုအပ်သည်။

q: Heat transfer and work are both energy in ____.
e: Heat နှင့် work သည် transient energy transfers ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Internal energy is a form of energy completely different from either heat or ____.
e: Internal energy သည် state function ဖြစ်သည်။

q: A thermodynamic process may be defined as a change from one ____ state of a system to another.
e: Processes များသည် equilibrium states ကို ချိတ်ဆက်သည်။

q: In thermodynamics, a ____ process (also known as a quasi-equilibrium process) is a thermodynamic process that happens slowly enough for the system to remain in internal physical thermodynamic equilibrium.
e: Quasi-static processes များသည် near-equilibrium ကို ထိန်းထားသည်။

q: An isobaric process occurs at constant ____.
e: Isobaric ဆိုသည်မှာ pressure constant ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The work done by the system in an isobaric process is simply the pressure multiplied by the change in ____.
e: Work သည် pressure နှင့် volume ပြောင်းလဲမှု မြှောက်လဒ်နှင့် ညီသည်။

q: An isochoric process occurs at constant ____.
e: Isochoric ဆိုသည်မှာ volume constant ဖြစ်သည်။

q: When the volume of a thermodynamic system is constant, no ____ is done by the system because $W=p\Delta V=0$.
e: Volume ပြောင်းလဲမှု သုညဖြစ်လျှင် mechanical work သုညဖြစ်သည်။

q: According to the first law, the change in internal energy must equal any ____ flowing into or out of the system.
e: Isochoric processes တွင် $\Delta U = Q$ ဖြစ်သည်။

q: An isothermal process occurs at a constant ____ (i.e. $\Delta T=0$).
e: Isothermal ဆိုသည်မှာ temperature constant ဖြစ်သည်။

q: For a process to be isothermal, any heat flow into or out of the system must occur ____ to maintain the thermodynamic equilibrium of the system.
e: Heat exchange နှေးခြင်းက temperature ကို constant ထိန်းထားသည်။

q: However, for an ideal gas, internal energy U is only a ____ of the temperature.
e: Ideal gases အတွက် U သည် T ပေါ်သာ မူတည်သည်။

q: In an isothermal process internal energy is constant; therefore, $\Delta U$ is equal to ____ for an isothermal process.
e: Temperature constant ဖြစ်လျှင် U ၏ ပြောင်းလဲမှု သုညဖြစ်သည်။

q: If the system does the work, the energy comes from heat flowing into the system from the ____.
e: Thermal reservoir က heat ကို ထောက်ပံ့သည်။

q: In an adiabatic process, there is no ____ transfer into or out of the system, i.e. $Q=0$.
e: Adiabatic ဆိုသည်မှာ heat exchange သုညဖြစ်သည်။

q: Heat engine is a system that converts heat to ____ energy, which can then be used to do mechanical work.
e: Heat engines များသည် mechanical energy ထုတ်လုပ်သည်။

q: A series of processes in which a system is brought back to its initial state is called a ____.
e: Thermodynamic cycle သည် စတင်သော state သို့ ပြန်ရောက်သည်။

q: The purpose of a heat engine is to deliver ____ continuously to the outside by performing the same cycle over and over again.
e: Heat engine ၏ output သည် useful work ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Thermal efficiency for a heat engine is the ____ of work output to heat input.
e: Efficiency သည် work-to-heat ratio ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The transformation of heat into work is usually accomplished in practice by two general types of engine; the internal ____ engine and the steam engine.
e: Internal combustion engines များသည် fuel ကို အတွင်း၌ လောင်ကျွမ်းစေသည်။

q: In both engines, a gas or a mixture of gases contained in a ____ undergoes a cycle.
e: Cylinders များသည် working gas ကို ထားရှိသည်။

q: There are two types of internal combustion engine (gasoline engine and diesel engine) that generates the input heat by the ____ of fuel within the engine itself.
e: Fuel combustion က input heat ကို ပေးသည်။

q: In the gasoline engines, the combustion of the gasoline and air takes place explosively by an electric ____.
e: Spark plugs များသည် gasoline mixtures ကို စက်နှိုးသည်။

q: The cycle involves the performance of six processes, of which four require motion of the piston and are called ____.
e: Piston ရွေ့လျားမှုများကို strokes ဟု ခေါ်သည်။

q: Intake stroke: A mixture of gasoline vapour and air is drawn into the cylinder by the ____ stroke of the piston.
e: Suction က fuel-air mixture ကို ဆွဲသွင်းသည်။

q: Compression stroke: The mixture of gasoline vapour and air is ____ until its pressure and temperature rise considerably.
e: Compression က temperature နှင့် pressure ကို မြှင့်တင်သည်။

q: Explosion: Combustion of the hot mixture is caused to take place very ____ by an electric spark.
e: Ignition သည် လျင်မြန်စွာ ဖြစ်ပေါ်သည်။

q: Power stroke: The hot combustion products ____ and push the piston out, thus suffering a drop in pressure and temperature.
e: Expand နေသော gases များက piston ပေါ် work လုပ်သည်။

q: Valve exhaust: The combustion products at the end of the power stroke are still at a ____ pressure and temperature than the outside.
e: Exhaust gases များသည် ပိုပူပြီး pressure ပိုမြင့်သည်။

q: Exhaust stroke: The piston pushes almost all the remaining combustion products out of the cylinder by exerting a pressure sufficiently ____ than that of the outside pressure.
e: Piston က exhaust ကို တွန်းထုတ်သည်။

q: The diesel engine operates on either a two-stroke or four-stroke cycle; however, unlike the spark-ignition gasoline engine, the diesel engine induces only ____ into the combustion chamber on its intake stroke.
e: Diesels များသည် အစတွင် air သာ compress လုပ်သည်။

q: Diesel fuel is sprayed into the cylinder by the injector (nozzle) and immediately ____ because of the heat and pressure inside the cylinder.
e: Compression heat မြင့်ခြင်းက diesel ကို auto-ignite စေသည်။

q: The pressure created by the combustion of the fuel drives the piston ____.
e: Combustion pressure က piston ကို အောက်သို့ တွန်းသည်။

q: In 1824, ____, French engineer, described a hypothetical engine known as Carnot engine.
e: Carnot က ideal engine ကို စိတ်ကူးဖော်ခဲ့သည်။

q: It is a heat engine operates on an ideal ____ cycle (Carnot cycle) between two heat reservoirs.
e: Carnot cycle သည် perfectly reversible ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Carnot engine sets an ____ limit on the efficiency of all other real engines, such as steam engines, gasoline and diesel engines.
e: Real engine မည်သည့်အရာမျှ Carnot efficiency ကို မကျော်နိုင်။

q: All real engines are less efficient than Carnot engine because they do not operate through a reversible cycle, and efficiency is further reduced due to ____ and energy losses by conduction.
e: Friction က real engine efficiency ကို လျှော့ချသည်။

q: In a reversible process, the system undergoing the process can be returned to its initial ____ along the same path on the p-V diagram.
e: Reversible processes များသည် ၎င်းတို့၏ path အတိအကျကို ပြန်ခြေရာခံသည်။

q: A process that does not satisfy these requirements is an ____ process.
e: Real processes များသည် ယေဘုယျအားဖြင့် irreversible ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The most important condition for a process to be reversible in thermodynamics is that the process should be carried out ____ slowly.
e: Infinitesimal slowness က equilibrium ကို ထိန်းထားသည်။

q: The working substance of a Carnot engine is an ____ gas contained in a cylinder fitted with a movable piston at one end.
e: Carnot engines များသည် theoretically ideal gas ကို သုံးသည်။

q: The Carnot cycle consists of four reversible processes; two isothermal processes and two ____ processes.
e: Carnot cycles များသည် isothermal နှင့် adiabatic steps ကို အလှည့်ကျလုပ်သည်။

q: Carnot analyzed the transformation of energy during one complete cycle of this engine's performance and determined the conditions for ____ efficiency.
e: Carnot က maximum theoretical efficiency ကို တည်ဆောက်ခဲ့သည်။

q: Kelvin proposed that we use a Carnot engine as a ____ and define the ratio of two temperatures as the ratio of the heat absorbed by the engine to the heat rejected.
e: Carnot engines များသည် absolute thermodynamic temperature scale ကို သတ်မှတ်သည်။

q: Although Carnot engine is not ____ efficient, but it is more efficient than other machine in transforming heat into work.
e: Heat engine မည်သည့်အရာမျှ perfectly efficient မဖြစ်နိုင်။

q: ____ theorem states that no engine operating between two heat reservoirs can be more efficient than a Carnot engine operating between the same reservoirs.
e: Carnot's theorem သည် efficiency limit ကို သတ်မှတ်သည်။
